author: wolfyyy
quote: Rockstar and their nasty practices are unacceptable and the features that were making GTA fun are missing : you can’t be a taxi driver, you can’t dial numbers, you can’t steal every car at beginning, you can’t sleep with people at all, there is no FPS view to enjoy to drive… the world is realistic and impressive but you can already feel the repetitively if you are not doing any mission, plus it’s pretty janky sometimes, you get random encounters but it doesn’t go too far unless it’s planned side quests. Red Dead Redemption 2 was a greater game.
